newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ASSIDOMAN SEES OCT KRAFTLINER PRICE RISE.
newsitem.headline: ASSIDOMAN SEES OCT KRAFTLINER PRICE RISE.

text.p: Swedish forestry group AssiDoman said on Tuesday it expected prices of unbleached kraftliner to be increased by eight to ten percent around October 1.
"We expect this will go through," AssiDoman's managing director Lennart Ahlgren told a news conference after the company released its six month results.
Earlier this year AssiDoman raised prices of bleached and unbleached kraftliner in Europe by six to eight percent, Ahlgren said.
Ahlgren said he expected continuing price rises for pine in the next six months while prices for spruce had fallen.
"Overall we think that timber prices will continue to rise at the same rate in the second half of the year," Ahlgren said.
